note: Attacker-controlled DH prime bytes from the ServerKeyExchange packet are converted into a BIGNUM.
The freshly built DH object is attached to an EVP_PKEY that becomes the temporary peer key.
The previous peer_tmp object must not still be reachable when it is freed; later code assumes the reference transfer and cleanup ordering are safe.
Freeing the DH object decrements the reference count and can release the structure while another path still uses it, producing the reported heap-use-after-free write.
